The '''Federation's Folly''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the city of [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was established after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Krett]].
